title: A MESSAGE FROM #BARTHOLOMEW THE #MARTYR
segments: as the sun begins to set on this
faithful day my heart feels heavy
burdened by the weight of my impending
Destiny my name is Bartholomew also
known as Nathaniel and I have been
called to be an apostle of the Lord
Jesus Christ throughout my calling I
have witnessed countless Miracles shared
the profound teachings of our savior and
travel far and wide to spread the
gospel's message for years I journeyed
across Asia from Village to Village
sharing the love of Jesus Christ with
all who would listen turkey became a
second home to me as I embraced the
warmth of its people eagerly sowing
seeds of faith in their hearts yet my
final mission took me to Armenia where
our brothers are scattered and where the
dark clouds of persecution looms
overhead it's here that I face the
ultimate test of my faith the tormentors
fueled by the disdain for my beliefs
condemn me to a gruesome fate the whip
you hold tightly within your hands will
soon be the instrument of my martyrdom
with every strike of the Lash I could
feel my flesh tear and my strength Wayne
pain cing through my body but my spirit
remains unyielding in this moment of
Agony as the life blood begins to escape
me I felt a profound
peace my thoughts turn not to the agony
iing reality of my end but to the
Eternal promise our Lord have bestowed
upon me with the undeniable presence of
God's grace my final words I Proclaim
Jesus Son of God have mercy upon these
Souls forgive them for they know not
what they do emboldened by the strength
that only Faith Can bestow I cry out for
forgiveness and salvation of my brothers
who wish me harm in my last moments I
reflect on the remarkable privilege I
have been given to witness firsthand the
miracles of Jesus to hear his teachings
and to experience the Indescribable love
emanated from his very being I had
willingly dedicated my life to sharing
this message and now I would offer it up
as my final Testament as I take my final
breath my spirit was S free from the
limitations of this Earthly vessel in
the face of unspeakable pain
my faith will remain unshakable and
through my martyrdom I found a deeper
connection with our Lord My Sacrifice
would not be in vain for the seeds I had
sown would continue to Bear fruits in
the heart of those who would come to
know him and so as I depart this world I
carry with me the assurance that my work
is complete the Gospel of Jesus Christ
is alive thriving and forever etched
into the hearts of those who witnessed
my martyrdom my name may be forgotten
but the message I shared would endure
for an
eternity
